name: PNB MasterCard World Grand Debit Card
description: PNB MasterCard World Grand Debit Card is a PNB MASTERCARD WORLD GRAND from Punjab National Bank. International usage; ATM limit Rs. 150,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 500,000/day. Valid 7 years.
tagline: MasterCard World debit card from PNB — international usage with ATM + POS access.

benefits.title: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary Airport lounge access. Twice (2) (1 Cardholder + 1 Guest) per calendar quarter per card on domestic lounges. For updated lounge list, refer to MasterCard official website.

features: Can be used at all POS terminals, E Com Websites / Apps and ATMs across India

notes: All Individuals above 18 years of age maintaining Monthly Average Balance of Rs.5,00,000/- and account opened under eligible schemes.
